value: Initial-access hypothesis: the system was compromised via the 'Ease of Access' Magnifier backdoor (Magnify.exe replaced by cmd.exe), which yields a SYSTEM shell at the Winlogon screen; that SYSTEM shell was then used to create/promote the 'master' account and enable Administrator. The backdoor's own installation requires prior write access to System32 (physical/console access to the VM or an offline NTFS edit), and no remote (RDP/type-10) logon is present in the surviving logs, so remote access is not evidenced.
evidence: LSN order + Security.evtx 4624 LT=2 only (no LT=10 RDP) + TS-LSM Address=LOCAL for all sessions
